data.desc: AirJoule Technologies Corporation (Nasdaq: AIRJ) is an advanced technology company whose purpose is to free the world of its water and energy constraints. The company is commercializing its proprietary AirJoule technology for atmospheric water generation and dehumidification through a joint venture with GE Vernova. AirJoule Technologies also owns BitSink, a U.S. manufacturer of cooling, power distribution and modular infrastructure for AI and high-performance computing data centers.
